hook: Ethiopia accused Eritrea of a massive invasion into Tigray, raising fears of a renewed regional war.

sections.voiceover: Ethiopia accused Eritrea of a massive invasion into Tigray, raising fears of a renewed regional war.
b_roll: Satellite map highlighting the Tigray region border.

sections.voiceover: On Saturday, Ethiopian military vehicles and troops entered Adigrat near the border while residents celebrated. Where did the 60 kilometers advance reach?
b_roll: Archive footage of troops moving into Adigrat.
Map showing distance to the border.

sections.voiceover: Eritrea described Ethiopia's actions as a declaration of war, but asked the United Nations to take deterrent measures.
Addis Ababa reported a 60 kilometers advance as Ethiopian troops entered Adigrat near the border.
b_roll: Document graphic showing the letter to the UN.

sections.voiceover: Eritrea urged the United Nations to intervene in the standoff.
